newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria revokes licences of 97 mortgage banks.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria revokes licences of 97 mortgage banks.

text.p: Nigeria's banking authorities said on Wednesday they had revoked the operating licences of 97 mortgage banks in the country.
This reduces to less than 50 the number of financial institutions now qualified to carry on mortgage businesses.

Musa Bichi, managing director of the Federal Mortgage Bank, the regulatory authority in the sector, told reporters in Lagos that the revocation followed a thorough investigation of primary mortgage institutions.
"All applicants now know which mortgage banks to do business with," Bichi said.
All the institutions affected are locally-owned.
Scores of mortgage banks and other financial institutions sprang up in Nigeria after the deregulation of the finance sector in the mid 1980s.
Many have since closed because of fraud or mismanagement.
